name: Moonah Links
editorNote: Moonah Links offers two 18-hole courses, Open and Legends, alongside Peppers accommodation and on-site dining in Fingal. The Open Course hosted the Australian Open in 2003 and 2005; Legends gives the group a second course to compare on the same trip. Public players register online before viewing live tee times for either course.
